test.create(first)
test.set_value(first, 7)
test.create(second)
test.set_value(second, 3)
test.create(/least)
test.execute(operation<my.domain.com:my_lib:/smaller>, first, second, /least)
test.create(/smallest)
test.create(/largest)
test.execute(operation<my.domain.com:my_lib:/order>, first, second, /smallest, /largest)
test.destroy(first)
